title: Design-Build for Roof Repair of Building 370
short_description: Design-build roof repair and envelope remediation for Building 370 in Alpena, Michigan.
project_scope: Repair and modification of damaged roof areas at Building 370, including removal and replacement of roof troughs and gutters, repair and resealing of CMU walls and joints, installation of heated drip edge, and provision of metal flashing and sealant systems.
services: Design-build services for roof and building envelope repair and modification.
relevance_explanation:
- Small-scale general building repair project with limited structural complexity.
- Scope focuses on roof remediation, gutters, flashing, sealants, and CMU wall resealing rather than innovative structural design.
- No indication of long-span structures, bridges, special structures, or architecturally demanding building design.
- Design-build delivery includes some planning component, but the technical content is not strongly aligned with sbp's core profile.
construction_cost_explanation: Taken from the tender documents: Total Construction Cost $500.0K.
fee_explanation: No explicit planning fee stated in the tender documents.
